title: DONT BUY THEY SUCK TOTALLY CHEAP GARBAGE
text: DONT BUY THEY SUCK TOTALLY CHEAP GARBAGE. I threw these cheap P.O.S.  knives out. I doubt these are real Farberware cause theyre so cheaply made. Buyer beare you don't get what you paid for with these.

product_metadata.title: Farberware Steak Knives, Set of 6
features: High Carbon Stainless Steel Blades offer strength and durability
Non slip polypropylene helps to provide a sure grip, even when wet
Handles are permanently bonded to the blade
Perfectly weighted and Balanced for control
description: This 4-1/2-inch blade has a sharp point and a blade that curves upward toward the tip. This sharp blade cuts through thick steaks and chops.
